events.name: Winged Wonders at Sand Hollow
events.place: Sand Hollow State Park, 3351 Sand Hollow Rd
events.description: Sand Hollow gets over 250 bird species a year. Bring a chair or blanket and join a ranger off the main boat ramp near the jetty; binoculars are provided.

events.name: Community Action – Weed Pulling at Sand Hollow
events.place: Sand Hollow State Park, 3351 Sand Hollow Rd
events.description: Help a park ranger pull invasive plants that popped up after monsoon season at Sand Hollow.

events.name: Christmas on The Farm
events.note: 2026 hours and prices not posted yet.
events.description: The Farm's winter season with holiday lights, Christmas music and barnyard animals. Depending on the day there are Santa visits, tractor rides, slides and kid zones. Tickets are booked online by date.

events.name: Hurricane City Christmas Tree Lighting
events.place: Hurricane Community Center & Splash Pad, 63 S 100 W
events.description: Hurricane's community tree lighting with donuts and hot cocoa, a live nativity, horse-drawn carriage rides and a visit from Santa.

events.name: Hurricane Valley Christmas Tree Festival
events.description: Decorated Christmas trees up for auction, a bake sale, local vendors, Christmas trains, nativity displays, raffles and live entertainment, plus Santa. Proceeds benefit the Hurricane Police Department's Shop with a Cop program.
